decisions.statement: The page is committed and the file beside that page is not.
A row holds what one page states and nothing worked out across pages.
A row is keyed by the path of the page that row is of.
A landing replaces the rows of the pages its change names and keeps the rest.
A page holding nothing the picture draws has no row here.
A file with no line yet is drawn by reading every page once.

definition: the per-page facts a part of the editor draws its picture from
